The Lorentz mappings cover the four-real Hermitian carrier, determinant form, equality of the positive and future cones, determinant-one form invariance, future-unit stabilizer equation and central-sign action. The recorded hashes identify this semantic review only. Compiled verification is recorded separately by the matching verification manifest.

manuscript_snapshot_method: Starting from main.tex, recursively resolve local TeX input/include files. Sort relative POSIX paths in ordinal order. Hash the UTF-8 concatenation of relative_path, NUL, lowercase file SHA-256, LF for each file. The graph includes main.tex and local macro inputs; class/style files, bibliography files and external images are excluded. These identities locate the reviewed sources and do not certify semantic coverage.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumann_selfAdjoint

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumann_domain_iff
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic

declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:correlation-spectrum

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumann_eigenvector_iff
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: prop:unlabeled-spectral-classification

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.TraceLieGeometry.norm_sq_eq_trace

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.TraceLieGeometry.unit_orientation_existsUnique

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.OriginalLieFlow.minimalCarrier_original_phase_flow
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: eq:generated-u-one-realization

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.circleHaarNormalization
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:reflecting-double

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.reflectingHaar_unitary
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:reflecting-double
declarations.scope: Actual folding reflection, followed by the measure normalization, is a unitary from complex L2([0,L]) onto the usual reflection-even Haar circle subspace. Shifted-window and angular-coordinate transport, and the Haar operator conjugacy, remain separate.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannCosineBasis

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannCosineMode_succ_coe
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic

declarations.scope: Every positive basis mode has the actual interval representative sqrt(L)^(-1) sqrt(2) cos((n+1) pi x/L); the zero-mode constant and normalized reflection formula are also proved. This identifies functions and normalization without assuming differential spectral completeness.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.ZeroMoments.ae_eq_zero_of_all_moments_eq_zero

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteMoments.weightedSource_exponential_integrable

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteCompleteness.basis

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteCompleteness.hasSum_expansion
declarations.paper: The Spectrum of a Compact Internal Space I: Gauge Structure and a Scalar Mass Gap

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.EigenbasisClosure.selfAdjoint_extension_unique

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteOscillator.hamiltonian_selfAdjoint

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteOscillator.hamiltonian_domain_iff

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteOscillator.selfAdjoint_extension_unique

declarations.label: cor:gaussian-central-sign

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.RepresentationDifferential.unit_endomorphism_properties

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.PeriodicIntervalH2.globalRepresentative

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.native_irreducibles_infinite
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: cor:infinitely-many-spectral-primes
declarations.scope: Composition-irreducible actual circle modes form an infinite set. declarations.label: eq:internal-difference-ring-order

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.Differences.positive_native_unique
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: lem:internal-ordered-difference-ring
declarations.scope: Every strictly positive element of the actual difference ring has a unique nonzero native-mode representative. Its full nonnegative cone is exactly the image of the proved injective semiring embedding.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.Differences.difference_is_integral_domain
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: lem:internal-ordered-difference-ring
declarations.scope: The actual pair quotient is a nontrivial linearly ordered commutative integral domain. Ring laws descend from native representative operations, and positive multiplication follows from nonzero native composition. No ordinary-integer ring structure or order is assumed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.Differences.bezout_in_difference_ring
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: prop:intrinsic-bezout
declarations.scope: For any two actual modes, the gcd constructed by native remainder descent is a linear combination of their embeddings in the constructed difference ring. declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.Differences.additive_extension_existsUnique
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: lem:internal-ordered-difference-ring
declarations.scope: Every additive homomorphism from actual modes to any additive commutative group has a unique extension to the actual pair quotient. The extension is constructed by the representative formula f(a)-f(b), proving the Grothendieck group universal property.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.Differences.ring_extension_existsUnique
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: lem:internal-ordered-difference-ring
declarations.scope: Every semiring homomorphism from actual modes to any commutative ring has a unique ring-homomorphism extension to the constructed difference ring, with the same representative formula. declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:reflecting-double

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GaussianLadderCore.gaussian_ladder_unique_on_hilbert_core

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GaussianLadderCore.hilbert_ordered_products_eq_canonical
declarations.paper: The Spectrum of a Compact Internal Space I: Gauge Structure and a Scalar Mass Gap
declarations.label: prop:canonical-gaussian-ladder-p4

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.native_euclid
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: lem:spectral-euclid
declarations.scope: An irreducible actual circle mode dividing a composite divides one of its two factors. The proof uses the native gcd and positive-part Bezout equality, followed by additive cancellation. It does not invoke natural-number primes or assume a difference-ring divisor theorem. declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.NativeModes.native_factorization_unique
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: prop:unique-spectral-factorization
declarations.scope: Any two finite lists of composition-irreducible actual circle modes having the same product are permutations of one another. The proof removes common factors using the native Euclid lemma and cancellation; no integer factorization theorem is used.

declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:spectral-factorization

Existence uses descent in the native additive order; uniqueness uses the internally proved divisor property. The complete Neumann-spectrum bridge and subsequent comparison with ordinary prime labels are separate.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.SmoothCharacter.minimalCarrier_character_smooth
declarations.paper: A Spectral Construction of Natural-Number Arithmetic
declarations.label: thm:minimal-scalar-group

Smoothness is obtained from Haar averaging against a smooth bump with a proved nonzero mean; it is not an input and no atlas is replaced. Injectivity of the Lie differential, its trace normalization and the exponential-flow identification remain separate.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GaussianAffineLadder.gaussian_affine_ladder_unique
declarations.paper: The Spectrum of a Compact Internal Space I: Gauge Structure and a Scalar Mass Gap

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GaussianAffineLadder.core_adjoint_le_hilbert_adjoint

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.reflectingDouble_unitary

declarations.scope: The existing orthogonal residual minimizes the full Gaussian prefix response among all multiples of the same eliminated observation. The exact deviation square is retained by shifted_square, including zero eliminated curvature.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixResolutionResponse.reduced_response_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: Gaussian transport with the response reduction recomputed
declarations.scope: The capacity-restored orthogonal reduced response contracts by exp(-t/L^2) when alpha advances at fixed L. The optimal coefficient is recomputed in the actual new reference, while the old optimized residual is used only as a comparison direction. All null-direction cases are included.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixResolutionResponse.native_transverse_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: native restored Mobius-support capacity under Gaussian resolution
declarations.scope: For the original generated Mobius and square-free support observations, the same complete-response contraction applies to C-B^2/C with both C and B restored in the original Gaussian normalization at each alpha. The true unit and all original signs remain present.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.joint_step_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual birth and complete Gaussian resolution in one ledger
declarations.scope: The original capacity-restored root response at N+1 and alpha+t, plus its full resolution loss, equals the old N response at alpha plus the actual new-root fluctuation. The new mass, old mean and conditional history-phase law are internally computed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.commuting_rectangle
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: compatibility of the two actual update orders
declarations.scope: The difference of the actual birth fluctuations at the two Gaussian references is balanced by the difference of the corresponding complete resolution losses. No monotonicity or decay of the birth contribution is assumed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.joint_step_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete actual birth followed by native Gaussian contraction
declarations.scope: At fixed L the entire N+1 response contracts by exp(-t/L^2) relative to the sum of the old response and its computed birth contribution. Both updates retain their own parameters and original capacity.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.complete_matrix_joint_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete matrix birth and resolution balance
declarations.scope: The actual within-birth and cross-birth matrix responses at the old reference equal the complete response at the new reference plus its original kernel loss and mean-change square. No cross-label entry is removed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.cross_birth_resolution_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact response loss on the actual cross-birth block
declarations.scope: The cross-birth matrix observation has zero diagonal and therefore zero mean at both actual references. Its full restored response loss is exactly its logarithmic-mean kernel loss, with no re-centering remainder.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.cross_birth_response_exact
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: all original cross-birth matrix weights
declarations.scope: The capacity-restored cross-birth response is the sum over every ordered old/new history-phase pair of the original logarithmic-mean kernel times the squared matrix entry. The partition cancels exactly rather than being replaced by one.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.cumulative_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite cumulative actual birth and resolution balance
declarations.scope: For arbitrary nonnegative Gaussian observation increments, the final complete root response plus the sum of the independently computed positive resolution losses equals the initial response plus the actual accumulated birth fluctuations. The Gaussian coordinate is the sum of the actual increments.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixBirthResolution.cumulative_budget
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite source budget after retaining both update mechanisms
declarations.scope: The finite cumulative budget follows only after assembling the complete birth/loss identity and using positivity of its actual resolution losses. No bound on the sum of birth contributions is assumed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsFullResponse.response_gradient_hasFDerivAt
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: connected gradient at every Hermitian base
declarations.scope: The derivative of the same log-partition gradient exists at every finite Hermitian observation. The exponential derivative is taken on all matrix directions, without a commuting-direction restriction.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsFullResponse.hessian_spectral
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: full finite-observation spectral Hessian
declarations.scope: The full observed logarithm determines its Hermitian spectral decomposition. The same unitary transports both perturbation directions, and the exact Hessian is the positive logarithmic-mean Gibbs form in those coordinates.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsFullResponse.hessian_squares
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation positive square formula
declarations.scope: At every finite Hermitian observation the complete self-Hessian is the sum of the original logarithmic-mean weights times all squared centered matrix entries in the observed spectral coordinates, divided by the same partition.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsFullResponse.hessian_kernel
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation scalar kernel
declarations.scope: On the complete real Hermitian matrix space, at every finite Hermitian observation, a direction has zero pairing with all directions exactly when it is a real scalar matrix.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsFullResponse.hessian_traceless_pos
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: strict curvature on the traceless quotient
declarations.scope: Every nonzero traceless Hermitian direction has strictly positive response curvature at each finite Hermitian base observation. The assertion gives pointwise strict positivity, without asserting an observation-independent coercivity constant.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.full_hessian
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete native prefix Hessian at finite observations
declarations.scope: The full spectral Hessian theorem applies to the actual Gaussian root/history/phase prefix. It retains both matrix directions and their common unitary transport, including all noncommuting cross-label entries.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.tilted_partition
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact original-source finite likelihood partition
declarations.scope: A finite diagonal observation f has partition sum I_i exp(f_i), with I_i the unchanged generated Gaussian root/history/phase reference intensity. No independently chosen state or normalization law is introduced.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.tiltedProbability_root_marginal
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite root likelihood preserves all conditional fibres
declarations.scope: For an observation depending only on the root, summing its actual tilted probability over every original history/phase fibre gives its Gaussian root mass times its exponential likelihood divided by the complete tilted partition.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.gradient_at_diagonal
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation gradient is the actual mean
declarations.scope: The first derivative in every diagonal direction is its exact likelihood-weighted mean in the original source. The original reference is recovered at zero observation.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.hessian_covariance
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: all finite-observation mixed covariances
declarations.scope: At every finite diagonal observation, the same-source connected Hessian in two arbitrary diagonal directions is their exact joint mean minus the product of their actual means.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.diagonal_variance_zero_iff
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete diagonal curvature degeneracy
declarations.scope: At any finite likelihood the variance direction has zero curvature exactly when its observable is constant on the full prefix carrier. All original intensities remain strictly positive.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.probe_curvature_pos
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: intrinsic Mobius curvature is strictly positive
declarations.scope: Every prefix containing the unit and first prime has strictly positive Mobius-probe curvature at every finite diagonal observation. Nonconstancy is proved using their actual opposite generated signs, without an assumed balanced mean.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.centre_curvature
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: intrinsic center curvature at every finite likelihood
declarations.scope: The complete occupation-center response at a finite diagonal observation is exactly one minus the square of its actual tilted mean. No vanishing reference mean is imposed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.probe_curvature
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual Mobius and support nonlinear curvature
declarations.scope: At every finite diagonal observation the Mobius self-curvature is the actual square-free support fraction minus the square of the actual signed mean, retaining its zero values on the complement.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.support_curvature
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual support nonlinear curvature
declarations.scope: The square-free support self-curvature is s times one minus s, where s is computed from the same likelihood-weighted full positive prefix state.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.probe_support_curvature
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual probe-support mixed curvature
declarations.scope: The mixed Mobius/support Hessian is m times one minus s at every finite diagonal observation. Both m and s use the identical full source, partition and likelihood.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixNonlinearResponse.generated
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: closed native nonlinear response interface
declarations.scope: The zero-argument generated conclusion bundles complete finite-observation curvature and scalar kernel, the exact original-source likelihood partition, all mixed diagonal covariances, and intrinsic strict Mobius curvature for prefixes containing the unit and first prime.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsSchurResponse.schur_identity
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete Gibbs Schur identity at an actual reference
declarations.scope: The full Hermitian response is its orthogonally reduced response plus the exact removed square in the same Gibbs metric. Scalar zero-curvature directions are included.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsSchurResponse.shifted_square
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact cost of a nonoptimal elimination coefficient
declarations.scope: For any real coefficient the retained response differs from the optimal Schur response by the actual eliminated curvature times the squared coefficient mismatch.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsSchurResponse.unique_coefficient
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: unique nondegenerate observation elimination
declarations.scope: When the actual eliminated response curvature is nonzero, its orthogonal coefficient is unique; no invertibility is imposed on scalar null directions.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Operations.GibbsSchurResponse.reduced_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: reference-compatible Schur contraction
declarations.scope: A proved comparison of every logarithmic-mean kernel entry also contracts the capacity-restored Schur response after recomputing its coefficient at the new reference.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.partition_likelihood
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete observed Gaussian partition
declarations.scope: At a finite diagonal observation every original root-history-phase intensity is multiplied by its exact exponential likelihood before summing the complete partition.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.form_hessian
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation full response metric
declarations.scope: The metric is the actual second derivative of the original connected response at the diagonal observation, in any two Hermitian perturbation directions, including noncommuting directions.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.tiltedLog_shift
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual root-square direction at finite likelihood
declarations.scope: Holding the diagonal observation fixed, the observed log intensity at alpha+t equals its old value minus t*n^2/L^2. Both the real conditional fibre law and the likelihood remain unchanged.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.complete_kernel_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation Gaussian kernel contraction
declarations.scope: The complete observed logarithmic-mean kernel contracts by exp(-t/L^2), independently of the prefix size and finite likelihood, at fixed L and nonnegative resolution increment t.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.complete_mixed_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation mixed resolution ledger
declarations.scope: The capacity-restored mixed response difference retains the full old-centered matrix pairing in both actual references and their two actual mean changes.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.complete_square_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation positive resolution balance
declarations.scope: The old complete response equals the new response plus the original centered-entry kernel loss plus the actual re-centering square, with the original observed partitions restored.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.kernelLoss_nonneg
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: positive complete kernel loss at finite likelihood
declarations.scope: Every ordered centered matrix-entry loss is nonnegative under the actual Gaussian log-intensity decrease, including all offdiagonal and cross-root entries.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.meanLoss_nonneg
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: positive observed re-centering cost
declarations.scope: The mean-change cost is the new complete observed partition times the squared difference of its actual matrix means.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.complete_response_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: finite-observation complete response contraction
declarations.scope: At any fixed finite diagonal likelihood, every complete capacity-restored Hermitian response contracts by the actual exp(-t/L^2) multiplier, uniformly in prefix size and likelihood.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.schur_identity
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact observed Schur response
declarations.scope: Orthogonal reduction in the actual finite-observation Hessian retains its full removed square, including the scalar-kernel case.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.reduced_response_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: reoptimized finite-observation contraction
declarations.scope: The complete Schur response recomputed at the new observed Gaussian reference satisfies the same exp(-t/L^2) bound. The old minimizing coefficient is not silently reused.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.probe_support_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual observed Mobius-support mixed ledger
declarations.scope: The native Mobius probe and square-free support retain their actual means and complete capacities on both sides of the Gaussian resolution update; no balanced root mean is assumed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedResolution.cumulative_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact cumulative observed resolution balance
declarations.scope: For every finite sequence of nonnegative Gaussian increments at fixed prefix, scale and diagonal observation, the exact kernel losses and actual re-centering costs telescope to the initial complete response.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.rootPartition_sum
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual root likelihood marginal
declarations.scope: The complete original history-phase fibres sum to their Gaussian root masses multiplied by the same finite root likelihood, before normalization.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.partition_succ
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual finite-observation birth capacity
declarations.scope: Extending the natural prefix adds exactly the Gaussian mass of root N+2 times its finite exponential likelihood, together with its complete conditional history-phase fibre.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.weighted_rootMean_succ
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact unnormalized observed birth mean
declarations.scope: The old complete weighted observation and the actual newborn likelihood mass give the full new weighted observation without a freely supplied transition probability.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.rootMean_succ
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual observed birth fraction
declarations.scope: The normalized root mean uses the newborn fraction computed from the same actual masses and partition; the old mean and newborn value are both retained.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.root_joint_response_succ
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete mixed birth covariance at finite likelihood
declarations.scope: The new mixed root response equals the actual old conditional response plus the exact between-birth covariance, including both actual old means and the likelihood-weighted newborn fraction.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.restored_old_capacity
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: observed conditional normalization cancellation
declarations.scope: Restoring the complete observed new partition exactly cancels its old-block probability and recovers the old observed capacity; the conditional fraction is not an extra source contraction.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.actual_birth_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual observed birth response balance
declarations.scope: The complete capacity-restored root response gains precisely the newborn likelihood mass times the old fraction times the squared deviation from the actual old observed mean.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.commuting_rectangle
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: birth-resolution compatibility at finite likelihood
declarations.scope: The two orders of actual Gaussian resolution and complete root birth have the same endpoint. The change in actual birth fluctuation is compensated exactly by the change in computed resolution loss.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.joint_step_contraction
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: observed birth and resolution contraction
declarations.scope: The whole newborn response, including its likelihood-weighted between-birth fluctuation, obeys the complete exp(-t/L^2) resolution bound at fixed scale.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.full_birth_response
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete observed cross-birth matrix response
declarations.scope: At any finite diagonal likelihood the full extended Hermitian response includes every ordered old/new history-phase matrix entry with its actual logarithmic-mean weight.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.complete_matrix_joint_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete observed matrix birth-resolution ledger
declarations.scope: The within-birth and cross-birth responses jointly equal the new full observed response plus its actual complete kernel loss and re-centering cost.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.cross_birth_resolution_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact cross-birth observed loss
declarations.scope: Cross-birth observations have zero diagonal at both actual references. Their complete observed resolution ledger therefore has exactly zero re-centering cost and retains the full kernel loss.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPrefixObservedBirth.cumulative_ledger
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact observed history birth-resolution balance
declarations.scope: For successive natural prefixes and actual Gaussian increments, the final observed root response plus every actual resolution loss equals the initial observed response plus every likelihood-weighted birth fluctuation.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceClosedCenterResponse.centre_trace_response_difference
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: physical centre trace of unequal chiral responses
declarations.scope: On the generated full sixteen-dimensional carrier, the centre trace of the two actual response blocks is exactly the trace of their operator difference. Common-response balance is its zero-difference specialization. No arithmetic result is used.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Source.CommonSource.generated
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: one common zero-input Gaussian source
declarations.scope: Both independent branch entries use this identical canonical source theorem. Unit covariance, the compositional law, three density times, state correlation and natural window are proved upstream.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Correlation.GeneratedSourceGround.coordinate_density
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: common oscillator ground density
declarations.scope: The actual Gaussian source law at b^2/2 has the oscillator ground-profile squared density in any trace-line isometric coordinate. Positive width and the original compositional-law premises remain explicit.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.MathematicalInterface.generated
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: zero-input arithmetic response interface
declarations.scope: The actual history, phase, matrix, response, reaction, occupation and shared differential systems are assembled without carrier, probability law, rate or positivity-certificate arguments and without importing Physical modules.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryObservation.energy_decomposition
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual weighted reflection decomposition
declarations.scope: On the actual complete history fibre, the generated positive law is reflection invariant. Its even and odd projections reconstruct every observation and their weighted energies add exactly.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryPhaseBundle.probability_unique
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: unique complete history-phase law
declarations.scope: Translation invariance together with the already generated history marginal uniquely determines the positive probability on the actual history-phase fibre.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryPhaseBundle.energy_decomposition
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: retained phase-compression energy
declarations.scope: The actual phase average is orthogonal to its retained zero-average residual for the generated history-phase probability. Both energies are retained.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryMatrixAlgebra.tomography
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: full arithmetic finite matrix tomography
declarations.scope: The action on the actual history-phase coefficient space determines every matrix coefficient, including off-diagonal coefficients.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.OccupationResponse.complete_energy_composition
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: whole-root occupation energy composition
declarations.scope: For native positive generated modes, energy is root^2-1 and multiplicative composition gives E(xy)=E(x)+E(y)+E(x)E(y). The joint term is retained.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.OccupationResponse.heat_nonvacuum_le
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual occupation heat damping
declarations.scope: Every native nonvacuum prime occupation has energy at least 3, and its heat weight is at most exp(-3t) for forward time. This is the occupation Hamiltonian, not the reaction generator.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryGibbsResponse.hessian_covariance
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: connected Hessian of the actual history probability
declarations.scope: The complete matrix log-partition Hessian restricted to actual diagonal history observations equals covariance under the generated persistent history law.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryPhaseResponse.generated
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: full history-phase Hermitian response
declarations.scope: The strictly positive reference is Gaussian root mass times the uniquely generated phase law. Its partition, normalized weights, full connected Hessian, scalar kernel and response rank are proved.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryCentralResponse.generated
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual history orientation fluctuation-response
declarations.scope: At every exponential probe coordinate, the log-partition derivative is the actual orientation mean and its derivative is the actual variance. Reflection gives zero unperturbed bias; the unperturbed variance is computed from the real history law, not imposed to be one.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionForm.full_mixed_expansion
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: full three-leg reaction action
declarations.scope: Every actual additive and multiplicative assembly contributes its Gaussian conductance times (parent-left-right)^2, with all three pairwise mixed terms retained.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionOperator.mixed_hessian_operator
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: actual action-Hessian operator identity
declarations.scope: The mixed variation of the actual reaction action equals the coefficient pairing with its incidence-conductance-adjoint operator.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionKernel.operator_zero_iff_leaf
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete finite reaction nullspace
declarations.scope: For N>=1 the entire kernel consists exactly of leaf charge multiplied by the unit-leaf value. It is not the constant-function kernel of an ordinary graph Laplacian.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionKernel.equilibrium_unique_stationary
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: unique anchored actual reaction equilibrium
declarations.scope: At each natural finite cutoff N>=1, prescribing the unit-leaf value selects a unique stationary actual history coefficient vector.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionComplex.unique_primitive
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: complete finite history integration
declarations.scope: Every actual reaction one-cochain has a unique zero-cochain primitive after fixing its unit value to zero. The proof recursively retains both children and the unique parent assembly.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionComplex.dirac_square
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: graded history operator square
declarations.scope: The weighted symmetric graded operator on actual zero- and one-cochains squares to the full previously derived reaction Hessian and the actual degree-one Laplacian.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionCovariance.action_covariant
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: covariance of the full history action
declarations.scope: Actual reflection reindexes every assembly and preserves its original Gaussian conductance, hence the entire common action and its mixed Hessian.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionFlow.energy_hasDerivAt
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: exact reaction-flow coefficient dissipation
declarations.scope: The exponential of the full actual reaction generator has coefficient-energy derivative equal to minus the full reaction form, with no mixed terms removed.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Analysis.HistoryReactionFlow.charge_preserved

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryHaarSectionCovariance.actual_window_not_isotropic
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: haar-covariance-historyhaarsectioncovariance-actual-window-not-isotropic
declarations.scope: Unique full matrix inverse of the actual positive joint Gaussian precision on its original finite frequency-dependent support. Competitors may have arbitrary off-diagonal entries. Diagonal entries are actual Gaussian second moments and the total variance is their complete spectral sum. Distinct original lowest-sector precisions exclude isotropy whenever u^2+4<B. This is a uniqueness theorem for each actual observation window, not a selection theorem for the window.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryHaarSectionCommonBalance.branchForce_lt_capacity
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: common-balance-branchForce-lt-capacity
declarations.scope: The exact common heat-vertex Gaussian response is integrated on every original spectral window. Its full positive amplitude ray has exactly one unit-work equilibrium iff the actual heat-score capacity exceeds one. The exact saturation remainder and its finite-window bound are proved before the root classification. Different windows admit their own equilibria, so this unit-work protocol does not select a joint endpoint-window pair. No physical three-position condition, R=5 selection, or interacting Gibbs identity is inferred.

declarations.label: spatial-variation-stationary-iff-balance
declarations.scope: The original nonlinear connection--section action under a three-dimensional base-metric homothety with the original fibre response held fixed. The source polar metric and quotient volume determine contragredient factors and c^3 volume. The exact action is Y/c+c*K+c^3*V, with an exact stationary criterion and a strict global square gap. All positive stationary scales are classified for each fixed configuration: uniqueness iff Y>0 and K+V>0. This does not choose a source probability state, a spectral window, a four-dimensional TT endpoint, or the physical R=5 family.

declarations.name: GeneratedFoundations.Arithmetic.HistoryHaarSectionGeometricState.action_firstDeriv
declarations.paper: Lean Formalization of Arithmetic and Basic Physical Interfaces
declarations.label: geometric-state-action-firstDeriv
declarations.scope: The original full nonlinear three-dimensional spatial action is differentiated before its finite quadratic state is formed. Connection and scalar precisions are lambda/c and c*a+c^3*C_F, respectively, with both real quadratures retained. Exact relative partition, geometric force, complete direct-minus-fluctuation response, and identical-support invariance are proved. This is the spatial zero-frequency fixed-support state; it does not assert interacting-state, moving-cutoff, or joint state-endpoint-window uniqueness.
